notifications.title: Scouts from Mirogost found a forgotten ruin
notifications.body: A Old Hillfort lies at (-5, 5). Send an army to explore it.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (3, -4)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 1750 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: Scouts from Mirogost found a forgotten ruin
notifications.body: A Stone Idol lies at (0, -2). Send an army to explore it.

notifications.title: Scouts from Mirogost found no ruins
notifications.body: They searched the land around it and came back empty-handed.

notifications.title: Scouts from Mirogost found a forgotten ruin
notifications.body: A Kurgan lies at (-4, 7). Send an army to explore it.

notifications.title: Scouts from Mirogost found no ruins
notifications.body: They searched the land around it and came back empty-handed.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (-5, 0)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 1400 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: Done: Train defenders
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: Scout Lodge level 1 in Mirogost
notifications.body: Finished.

notifications.title: Done: Raise a building
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (-1, -4).
